reading.text:
# Reading: def WellPosedness.System.CadlagPredTuple.mk (constructor)

The constructor of CadlagPredTuple. Its meaning is its argument list, which must be the fields of
the Lemma A.1 hypothesis tuple: the processes X, Y, Z, U with the correct value spaces; X, Y
adapted to the standing filtration with cadlag paths; Z, U predictable versions (predictable
sigma-field of the standing filtration); and, if bundled, the square-integrability
E int_0^T (|X|^2+|Y|^2+|Z|_F^2+||U||^2) dt < oo. Faithful iff these and only these are required
(see the reading of CadlagPredTuple).

comparison.text:
# Comparison: def CadlagPredTuple.mk

The constructor takes exactly the fields of CadlagPredTuple: X_adapted, X_rightCont, X_leftLim,
Y_adapted, Y_rightCont, Y_leftLim, Z_pred, U_pred, X_sq, Y_sq, Z_sq, U_sq — the hypotheses of
Lemma A.1 (cadlag adapted X, Y; predictable Z, U; the square integrability). Nothing more,
nothing less; same representation choices as the structure (R-indexed processes, coordinate
families, U as a P (x) E representative, time-0 convention of the marked predictable
sigma-algebra, integrability as four energies).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Representation choices, each harmless:
1. Processes are indexed by all real times and required adapted and cadlag on all of R; a paper
   process on [0,T] extends (0 before time 0, frozen after T) without changing anything on [0,T].
2. Coordinate families: X, Y, Z as real coordinate processes and U as a real function of
   (omega, s, e) per coordinate, i.e. the P (x) E-measurable representative of (2.4) rather than an
   L^2(nu)-valued process.
3. U is predictable for the sigma-algebra generated by F x (r,q] x B with r >= 0 and nu(B) < oo,
   which for sigma-finite nu is P (x) E on positive times and forces a constant on times <= 0; a
   paper version needs modifying only on the Lebesgue-null time set {0}.
4. The integrability of Lemma A.1 is bundled as four coordinatewise finite energies, equivalent to
   the printed single condition.
